fixtures.description: Controlled launch with an invalid bundled sign-pack identifier, proving the released unavailable surface without changing product bytes.
Fresh installation with the bundled illuminated-sign pack and no local signs.
Bundled immutable sign-pack sample report with no customer data.
Deterministic monument-sign check with accepted wide and close PNG fixtures and a visible dark-section issue.
Deterministic camera-denial, low-storage, import, preview, and retry paths for the same draft.
Completed check and recheck variants for no-visible, could-not-verify, still-visible, and different-issue truth.
Visible-issue report followed by recorded work and a resolved recheck.
Multi-report and clerical-correction lineage with comparison, validation, saving, and completed states.
Saved report with one injected PDF-render failure and explicit retry recovery.
Completed local report with Settings, backup, diagnostics, erase, restore, and commerce routes enabled.
Repository-owned valid V4 backup used only for deterministic restore selection and validation.
Deterministic unavailable-mail feedback route with an exact sanitized diagnostic review.
Checked-in StoreKit Test monthly product with deterministic paywall purchase and lifecycle states.
